lines.zh: 我滚过水底，泥沙都翻起来
lines.en: I roll along the bed, churning the silt.

lines.zh: 我这么大一团，水都让开
lines.en: Water parts around my bulk.
I advance, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片水底
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole bed.
I plough through the weeds.

lines.zh: 我滚过的地方水流变了
lines.en: The current changes where I pass.
I work my way toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我沉下去又浮起，像块礁石
lines.en: I sink and rise like a reef.
Stones flatten under me.
I roll over a sunken log.
I turn slowly, but I do not stop.
I churn the water murky.

lines.zh: 我滚过的地方留下深痕
lines.en: A deep groove is left where I pass.
I have edged closer to the bank.

lines.zh: 我每转一圈都带起暗流
lines.en: Each turn drags an undertow.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地碾过整片浅滩
lines.en: I grind across the whole shallow.
I settle on the bottom like a mound.
I am far too big to hide.
Water pours in streams off my shell.
I only have to wait.
Things have started growing on my shell.
I rotate half a turn.
My breathing stirs the water faintly.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩被我占了大半
lines.en: I take up most of this shallow.
I am in no hurry to leave.
A sunken log rests against me.
I have soaked here a long while.
My ridges glint underwater.
I am thinking of nothing.
The bed is quiet, so here I stay.
The ground you stand on is not firm.
I lift, and the water clouds.
You are much smaller than I expected.
I am watching the water at your feet.
I am this large, and you still stand there.
I can reach you without moving.
That dark shape in the water is me.
Give me a little room.

lines.zh: 我的壳面比你的船还宽
lines.en: My shell is wider than your boat.
I roll over, slowly.
My shell has cracked.
I flinch, and water rushes in.
I am keeping that in mind.
I roll off course.
Even something this big can hurt.
One of my ridges is blunted.
I sink to recover.
The water took some of it.
I slowly right my body.
I am still in this water.
You dropped something that small?
Not enough to fill a seam in my shell.
I smell it, down here.
Throw it closer.
When I open, half the pool goes in.
Not worth the effort to move.
I am not short of food here.
Try dumping the whole basket.
I swallow without chewing.
Another, I am still hungry.
You hit me like a reef.
I did not shift an inch.
You bounce away.
I am too big to go around.
You stepped on the rim of my shell.
Water shoves outward around me.
That hurt you more than me.
My ridges scrape your leg.
Do not walk right along the water.
I shift aside a little.
There is only one this size.
This water cannot hold two.
I am only growing.
There is no need to bring that up.
Only one round shadow on the bed.

lines.zh: 我围着它慢慢转了整整一圈。
lines.en: I make one slow, full circle around it.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，不掺和这种事。
lines.en: Built like this, I stay out of such matters.
I go back to soaking in the water.
You will get no answer.
I sink a little lower.

lines.zh: 沉到底下的东西都归我
lines.en: Whatever sinks to the bottom is mine.
I grind it into the mud.
My rolling drags mud with it.
So small I nearly missed it.
I swallow, and nothing is left.
It is stuck in a ridge.
I roll along dragging it.
This is not worth it.
I press it underneath me.
I tuck it under my shell rim.

lines.zh: 水面的动静让我转向了你。
lines.en: A disturbance on the surface turns me toward you.
That little disturbance on the bed.
I begin to roll your way.
Even at this distance I can reach.
You are well within my reach.
If I move first, you have no chance.
I see the whole shallow.

lines.zh: 你在水里留下的痕迹我看到了
lines.en: I saw the trail you left in the water.
I speed up, bit by bit.
Do not stand on the water side.
I have been closing in.
Each roll raises the water an inch.
You have backed onto dry land.
I wait for you to step in again.
My shadow creeps toward you.
I am in no hurry; I am large.
Turn, and I turn with you.
Water surges out ahead of me.
I am getting closer.
This time I will not drift off.
The whole mass slams into you.
That hit harder than it looked.
Water sprays high.
You slide away from the impact.
A ridge bites into your leg.
And I grind back around.
You cannot block something this big.
All my weight was behind it.

lines.zh: 你退到礁石上，我就不追了。
lines.en: You back onto the reef, and I stop chasing.

lines.zh: 这一撞足够把你掀翻在地。
lines.en: This one slam is enough to knock you flat.
The whole riverbed darkens.

lines.zh: 我从黑水里一点点浮上来。
lines.en: I rise little by little out of the black water.
The surface bulges upward.

lines.zh: 我滚上来的时候，岸都湿了
lines.en: The bank soaks when I roll ashore.
This shallow can hold me.
I crush a line of weeds.
I turn once and take my place.
A mound has appeared on the bed.

lines.zh: 我的壳比这里的石头都大
lines.en: My shell is bigger than any stone here.
Let me sink and look around first.
The water boils and my shell scalds.
I am thrown onto the rocks.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，我反而撑不住
lines.en: Too little water, and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我整个掀出水面
lines.en: The blast heaves me right out of the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的壳缝里
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 魔法穿进水里，烧着我的棱
lines.en: Magic pierces the water and burns my ridges.
I have emptied these waters.
Lightning finds me across the shallows.
The riverbed is gone.
